subsetPolicyRationale: `s.wfc.grid3d@1` is one self-contained WaveFunctionCollapse problem document — grid extent, per-axis cell sizes, periodicity, tiles, adjacency rules, pins and masks. There is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation reads and writes the SAME value model through the SAME codec and dispatch, so `✳️any` is this artifact's only real scope.
